customManagers.description: Update a version annotated with a `# renovate:` comment on the preceding line (e.g. the pinned ESPHome release in the CI workflow and the setup script). Only the extensions in managerFilePatterns are scanned: .sh, .yml, .yaml, .json, .toml, .cfg, .ini and .txt. Annotating any other file — a Dockerfile, a Makefile, an extensionless script — does nothing until its pattern is added there

packageRules.description: The pinned ESPHome release lives in two files that must stay in sync, so update them in a single PR. ESPHome uses CalVer, so a new year is not a 'major' upgrade worth its own PR
